brief:
The Prisoners and Released Prisoners Affairs Commission said detainee Qassay Abdel Alyan, 27, from Al-Issawiya in occupied Jerusalem, faces harsh detention conditions at Gilboa prison, according to Shehab Wire. Alyan has endured chronic health problems since birth that are deteriorating while in custody, the commission reported.

The detainee's case underscores the intersection of medical vulnerability and carceral hardship. The commission cited difficult conditions within the facility without specifying the nature of his chronic illness or detailing particular circumstances of alleged mistreatment in detention.
